searchText: Can I have a question? What is the distinction between Ethereum's planned PoS and Ouroboros PoS protocol? If this is not the correct place, can someone direct me to somewhere I can ask? This is not the correct place to ask. There isn't a great place to ask for comparisons in general because a good answer requires someone who is an expert in both systems and there are very few such people. You can try Reddit. 🤷 Hey, I just noticed that Nimbus normalizes web3 endpoint URL e.g. I have url https://gateway.fm/ethereum/mainnet?apiKey=AaAaAa and nimbus actually requests https://gateway.fm/ethereum/mainnet?apiKey=aaaaaa that doesn't work if the api key is case-sensitive? Is there any way around that? This isn't really the right place to ask user support questions, the server is focussed on Ethereum R&D. I'd suggest logging a bug with Nimbus on that one - URL paths and query params are case sensitive.
